role: P1b-1: independent semantic contract verification (deployable equiv_gold proxy)
dev_results: v1 11/20, v2 11/20 contract-correct; x100 ratio/percent convention conflict is systematic (not prompt-fixable without overfitting dev); v2 frozen
proxy_fidelity_dev: on stored-correct subset (12): equiv(contract,stored)==equiv(contract,gold) 12/12 in BOTH v1 and v2
test_panel: P0-2 96-task normalized follow-up panel; contracts generated for all 96; PRIMARY metrics on 76 clean-test tasks (96 minus 20 dev)
verifier: single call, model large (Qwen2.5-14B-GPTQ), temperature 0, fixed 8-field JSON schema; inputs = question + numbered facts ONLY (no gold, no stored expression, no answers); parse fail = abstain; no repair loop
adjudication: deterministic, zero calls: random-perturbation equivalence (K=32, seed 7, rel tol 1e-6) between contract canonical_expression (f-refs->v-refs) and stored expression; mismatch typing (missing/extra operand, scale, operator structure, other); dependency check vs update_dependencies
primary_endpoint: on stored-correct stratum: reuse-harm caught (recall) vs safe retained (1-FPR); rows: V1 lexical checks / cross-model agreement / semantic contract / oracle equiv_gold
secondary: mismatch enrichment for regen-recover vs regen-harm; policy replay a=reuse if T>=tau else regenerate using frozen P0-2 A/B outcomes (zero workflow calls); verifier cost amortized n=1,2,5,10
fault_families: Family A latent/bookkeeping = negative control only (P1a: unidentifiable by construction); Family B observable semantic corruption = main evaluation (this panel)
budget: 96 test calls + 40 dev calls (2 rounds x 20), single model
